# Xolvyn
> Automated pull request review and auto-fix for engineering teams. Xolvyn maps
> how every file in a repository connects, then works in your team's pull
> requests — reviewing every PR, ranking findings by blast radius, and opening
> the fix as a pull request you can merge. Runs in the cloud; no install, no
> binary, no agent required. Private beta; launching 2026.

## What is Xolvyn?
Xolvyn is codebase intelligence built for engineering teams. It maps every file,
dependency, and architecture layer in a codebase, then puts that understanding
to work where the team already ships: it reviews every pull request in GitHub —
grading it, surfacing security findings, and ranking them by blast radius
(severity combined with how many files depend on the affected code) — and opens
the fix as a pull request for human review. A medium-severity bug on a file that
47 others import outranks a critical bug on an isolated file. Unlike local CLI
tools that serve one developer's AI agent, Xolvyn serves the team: seats, roles,
and a dashboard, with no install required.

## Key facts
- Reviews every pull request in GitHub: a grade, security findings, and blast radius, posted as a comment before merge.
- Auto-Fix opens remediation pull requests on GitHub/GitLab; human review required, nothing merges without approval.
- Ranks findings by blast radius (severity × number of dependent files), not CVSS alone.
- AST-based dependency mapping for TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, and Java.
- 50+ security checks + CVE scanning; OWASP/CWE-aligned; letter grade (A–D) and 0–100 score.
- Built for teams: runs in the cloud from a browser, no install/binary/agent; seats, roles, and an eng-lead dashboard.
- @mentor: AI assistant grounded in your real dependency graph, not generic training data.
- Privacy: shallow clone, in-memory analysis, immediate deletion; OAuth-only; never trains on user code.
- Free for public repositories; Team and Enterprise tiers.
